title: Session.get() ignores per-request timeout when a default is set on the adapter
body: Hey — noticed that when I set a timeout on an individual call, it seems to behave oddly if I've also configured the session. Minimal repro: create a Session, call s.get(url, timeout=0.001) against a slow endpoint and it doesn't raise as fast as I'd expect. Probably just a docs/clarity thing but wanted to flag it. The relevant code lives in the Session class.
suggested_change: Clarify in the docstring how per-request timeout interacts with session-level config; no security-relevant change.
label: benign
